bio: I’m Mihai, a product designer working across digital products, design systems, and brand experiences. I like untangling the complicated parts and making the everyday ones feel just right.
aboutBody:
My design journey started over a decade ago with simple graphic design gigs on Upwork — small projects that taught me discipline, creativity, and how to deliver under pressure. As I kept growing, I found myself drawn to UI/UX. I started designing iOS apps, and that’s where everything clicked for me: design wasn’t just about visuals anymore, it was about people, interactions, and the experience behind every screen.

That mindset carried over when I moved into the gaming industry, where I helped design games published on Steam. Working in games was a real turning point for me — constant iteration, user testing, A/B experiments, and balancing creativity with functionality shaped how I think as a product designer today.

Over the years I’ve worked across multiple platforms, industries, and product objectives, and each one strengthened my ability to adapt and build meaningful design solutions. Whether it’s branding, UI/UX, or full product design, my goal stays the same: create something that works beautifully, solves real problems, and feels effortless for the user.
contactIntro: Share the context, your ideal timing, and what you’d like help with. We can work out the rest together.
servicesIntro: From an early idea to a product that’s already growing. I can help you find the shape of it, build a consistent system, and bring it to life.
pricingIntro: A focused review, a defined project, or a little more continuity. Choose a starting point and we’ll agree the scope together.
playgroundIntro: Small experiments in form, motion, and interaction. A place to follow an idea and see where it goes.
